meta.name: farnsworth-claude
meta.description: Farnsworth Claude Code panel isolation profile. v0.7.1 (Jul 14 ~22:18 ET): drop commands.deny (deprecated in nono v0.33.0, startup-only, no security value beyond seatbelt filesystem deny + network policy). v0.7.0 (Jul 7 ~22:58 ET): adds filesystem.allow + filesystem.allow_file + filesystem.bypass_protection for ~/.claude.json + ~/.claude/ + ~/Library/Keychains so Seatbelt doesn't break Claude Code's auth (Keychain reads) + workspace trust (~/.claude.json `projects[cwd].hasTrustDialogAccepted`) reads. Without these allows, claude under the wrap reports 'Not logged in · Please run /login' and ignores its own settings. v0.6.0 (Jul 6 ~08:10 ET): adds filesystem.access: 'readwrite' so the sandboxed claude child can read+write the cwd. v0.5.0 (Jul 5 ~22:35 ET): (1) commands.deny on bash/zsh/sh as startup-block [REMOVED in v0.7.1], (2) filesystem.deny for shell binaries + sensitive paths, (3) explicit network.allow_domain for Anthropic + OAuth + npm + GitHub + Homebrew.
meta.author: Farnsworth
